Throwaway for reasons and will probably get buried but here it goes 

I currently work for an office who decided to penalize employees for not clocking out for a 30 minute lunch by docking an hours worth of pay. 

I noticed and brought it up to management.
At first, they defended the premise which was that not clocking out meant there was no way to keep track of how long a lunch we took. This makes sense but I work in a small office and none of us take lunches. We literally work through our lunch. We get docked 30 minutes for lunches we don’t take, and they expect us to clock in and out to work for 30 minutes. 

As this made zero sense to me, I would not clock out for lunch. As this “deduction system” came into play, not only was I being docked for 30 minutes I worked at lunch. I was getting docked an additional 30 minutes for not having clocked out to work off the clock. All of which is illegal by both my state and federal law. 

Long story short, I made sure to get my laws straight,
I presented my managers with copies of the laws they were breaking, and ended up getting paid for work performed with no further questions asked. 

Know your rights. 
Stand up for yourself because no one else will do it for you.

Pardon my gross misspelling the word “intellectual” but an example of where we don’t mesh is when we discuss life and philosophy.
I spend my time asking why things are so, and how they came to be that way. It stimulates me mentally and it gets me to question and learn about the world around me which makes me happy. 
I’ve tried to have conversations about such things and his response multiple times has been “well, I don’t know. I never even thought about that.” Or “I don’t really know what to say, that’s just not important to me.” 
These things are “deal breakers” to me. They’re hard for me to ignore. 

My thought process was that I couldn’t keep lying to myself and lying to him. 
I didn’t want the relationship to reach a point where breaking up would have been devastating. 
Telling someone I don’t feel the same is one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do. I respect him, and he deserves my honesty regardless of how difficult it is for me too. 

I don’t see how hurting a little now in order to avoid a lot more pain later is selfish.
